criteria.title: Derive the machine-state and memory contract between GRUB, transition assembly and C.
criteria.task: Annotate every state transition in boot.S from GRUB entry to kernel_main, including retained magic/info, direction flag, GDT, CR3, EFER, CR0 and stack alignment. Give the first instruction invalidated by one missing prerequisite.
criteria.purpose: A bootloader entry is not an ISO C call; a correct page count cannot prove a legal mode transition.
